So produce:

{
 "task":"T3",
 "note":"...hand off..."
}

Write short handoff: mention that previous round completed with A on T2, B on T3, C chose T4, D chose T1, total cost etc. Preserve allocation convention: next round assign A T2, B T3 again? Let's craft note ~300 chars.

Return only JSON.
